prompt:
A small remote-controlled rover travels from point P to point Q along a semicircular path of radius r = 14.0 m in a time of 11.0 s. Point Q is due east of point P.
(Use pi = 22/7 or 3.142.)

(a) Define displacement. [1]
(b)(i) Calculate the total distance travelled and the average speed of the rover. [1]
(b)(ii) State the magnitude and direction of the displacement from P to Q. [1]
(b)(iii) Calculate the average velocity of the rover, stating both its magnitude and direction. [1]

answer.text:
(a) Displacement is the distance moved in a specified direction (or the straight-line distance from start to finish with direction).
(b)(i) Distance = pi * r = (22/7) * 14.0 = 44.0 m. Average speed = 44.0 / 11.0 = 4.00 m s^-1.
(b)(ii) Displacement = 2 * r = 2 * 14.0 = 28.0 m due east.
(b)(iii) Average velocity = displacement / time = 28.0 m / 11.0 s = 2.55 m s^-1 due east.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.prompt: Magnitude and direction of average velocity

mark_scheme: Part (a) [1 mark]: Distance moved in a specified direction / straight-line distance from initial to final position with direction.
Part (b)(i) [1 mark]: Distance = 44.0 m AND average speed = 4.00 m s^-1.
Part (b)(ii) [1 mark]: 28.0 m (or 28 m) due east (direction required).
Part (b)(iii) [1 mark]: 2.55 m s^-1 due east (magnitude and direction required).
hints: Distance is the curved path length: half of the circumference (pi * r).
Displacement is the straight diameter between P and Q (2 * r) with its compass direction.
Average velocity is displacement divided by time.
solution:
(a) Displacement is the distance moved in a stated direction.
(b)(i) Distance = pi * r = 44.0 m. Average speed = 44.0 / 11.0 = 4.00 m s^-1.
(b)(ii) Displacement = diameter = 28.0 m due east.
(b)(iii) Average velocity = 28.0 / 11.0 = 2.55 m s^-1 due east.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Part (a): define displacement as distance moved in a specified direction (1 mark).
Step 2: Part (b)(i): distance = pi * 14.0 = 44.0 m; average speed = 44.0 / 11.0 = 4.00 m s^-1 (1 mark).
Step 3: Part (b)(ii): displacement magnitude = 2 * 14.0 = 28.0 m; direction = due east (1 mark).
Step 4: Part (b)(iii): average velocity magnitude = 28.0 / 11.0 = 2.55 m s^-1; direction = due east (1 mark).
